## Testing

- [ ] `composer phpunit`
- [ ] `composer phpstan`
- [ ] `composer phpcs`
- [ ] `composer rector`

## Documentation

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Tests cover the change
- [ ] This does not include a security report that belongs in [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/tomaj/omnipay-tatra/security/advisories/new)
